purpose: Real workload practicality audit, no algorithm changes or outcome-dependent input choice

datasets.name: NASA July1995 HTTP
datasets.license: Freely redistributable per publisher; no named SPDX license; traffic-pattern-only request
datasets.extraction: All valid rows in full July file. Status/timestamp independently retained if parseable; bytes dash missing omitted for bytes only; rejected line counts recorded.

datasets.name: Covertype
datasets.extraction: Full covtype.data.gz; raw integer columns; no rescaling

datasets.name: US Census1990 processed public release
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; Meek, Thiesson, Heckerman 2001 DOI10.24432/C5VP42
datasets.ordering: published file order, which upstream randomized; no additional permutation
datasets.extraction: Full USCensus1990.data.txt; retain publisher codes unchanged. Upstream discretized/coarsened some fields.

CAFS.native_type: u32 scalar; i32 AVX2 specialized. Same numeric values and 4-byte elements; signed input clone outside timer; no u64 widening.

timing.repeats: one Latin cycle equal to eligible method count per input/session
timing.process: fresh process per input/session; sequential pinned lowest allowed CPU
timing.order: randomized workload order each session; shuffled initial method order then cyclic rotation each repeat
timing.excludes: input load, numeric parsing, input copy, correctness check, logs, warmup
timing.reference: exact whole-array equality against sorted input

memory.mode: separate instrumented executable and process, global C++ new/delete plus CAFS aligned malloc wrappers tracked; requested heap bytes excludes allocator metadata/stack; OS working set peak also recorded

regression.source: original M.make unchanged; real/synthetic reported separately

decision: Report A/B/C only if justified. No thresholds/guards/ABW edits. No data replication or shuffling. Differences within 5% called near tie for descriptive win counts; all exact ratios retained. Must not infer independent machines from repeated sessions.
